lines.text_source: "Welcome to Shikk, home of[01]the best sailors in the[01]world![02]Know why? 'Cause Shikk is[01]on the only non-mud sea in[01]the world, that's why!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: "Bem-vindo a Shikk, lar dos[01]melhores marinheiros do[01]mundo![02]Sabe por que? Porque Shikk fica[01]no unico mar sem lama do mundo,[01]e so isso!"

lines.text_source: "My dad's a sailor![02]I'm waiting for his ship to[01]get in!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: "Meu pai e marinheiro![02]Estou esperando o navio[01]dele chegar!"

lines.text_source: "Huh? You want to know[01]whose boat that is?[02]I don't know, but whoever[01]the owner is, he's probably[01]at the pub."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: "Hein? Quer saber de quem e[01]aquele barco?[02]Nao sei, mas quem for o[01]dono provavelmente ta[01]no boteco."

lines.text_source: "I heard that the[01]Checkpoint's been closed[02]and that it's hard to get[01]here...[02]I wonder if we'll be able[01]to get out all right...?"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: "Ouvi dizer que o Posto[01]de Controle foi fechado[02]e que ta dificil chegar[01]aqui...[02]Sera que vamos conseguir[01]sair sem problema...?"

lines.text_source: "You can't fish in the Sea[01]of Mud, but you can fish[01]here, you know!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: "Nao da pra pescar no Mar[01]de Lama, mas aqui da,[01]sabia!"

lines.text_source: "They say this ocean[01]stretches all the way to[01]the western continent."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: "Dizem que esse oceano[01]se estende ate o[01]continente Ocidental."

lines.text_source: "Most of the menfolk of[01]this town are out on their[01]ships right now."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: "A maioria dos homens[01]daqui esta nos seus[01]navios agora."

lines.text_source: "I heard that in some[01]places they have boats that[01]sail on the sand![02]I'd like to see one of them[01]someday--the boats here only[01]sail on water."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: "Ouvi dizer que em alguns[01]lugares tem barcos que[01]navegam na areia![02]Queria ver um desses algum[01]dia -- os daqui so navegam[01]na agua."

lines.text_source: [14][02][02]"Whaaaat!?[02]You wanna ride on[01]our ship?"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][02][02]"O QUEEE!?[02]Voce quer uma carona[01]no nosso navio?"

lines.text_source: "Looking to hire a ship,[01]are you?[02]Well then, you should talk[01]to those sailors there."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: "Quer contratar um navio,[01]e?[02]Entao fale com aqueles[01]marinheiros ali."

lines.text_source: "Welcome. Come in![02][19]
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: "Bem-vindo. Entre![02][19]

lines.text_source: "Whoops--looks like[01]you're a little short[01]on zenny."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: "Ops -- parece que seu[01]dinheiro ta um pouco[01]curto."

lines.text_source: "Rare items from[01]across the sea! Care[01]to take a look?"[12][84][0C][94]Buy[01]Sell[01]Trade[01]Never mind
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: "Itens raros de alem-mar![01]Quer dar uma olhada?"[12][84][0C][94]Comprar[01]Vender[01]Trocar[01]Deixa pra la

lines.text_source: [14][02][02]"Hey, I dunno who you[01]think you are,[02]but we don't let jus'[01]anyone on our ship,[01]y'know!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][02][02]"Ei, nao sei quem voce[01]pensa que e,[02]mas nao deixamos qualquer[01]um no nosso navio,[01]ta!"

lines.text_source: [14][02][02]"Besides...[02]We can't let anyone[01]who doesn't have the[02]blessing of the [05][02]God[01]of the Sea[06] come with[01]us--it's bad luck![02]Now be off with ya!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][02][02]"Alem disso...[02]Nao podemos levar ninguem[01]que nao tenha a bencao do[02][05][02]Deus do Mar[06] com a gente --[01]da azar![02]Agora sumam daqui!"

lines.text_source: [14][02][02]"All of us sailors[01]get the blessing of[02]the [05][02]God of the Sea[06][01]before we go out on[01]our ships![02]We can't have anyone[01]without that blessing[01]on board, see?"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][02][02]"Todo marinheiro recebe[01]a bencao do[02][05][02]Deus do Mar[06][01]antes de zarpar![02]Nao podemos ter ninguem[01]sem essa bencao[01]a bordo, entendeu?"

lines.text_source: "Huh? Looking for the[01]God of the Sea?[02]That road there leads[01]to the [05][02]Fane of the[01]Sea God[06]."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: "Hein? Procurando o[01]Deus do Mar?[02]Aquela estrada leva[01]ao [05][02]Fane do[01]Deus do Mar[06]."

lines.text_source: [14][02][02]"Whaaat!?[02]You say you went to[01]the Fane of the Sea[01]God!?"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][02][02]"O QUE!?[02]Voce foi ao Fane do[01]Deus do Mar!?"

lines.text_source: [14][02][02]"This must be an[01]omen...[02]A sign of the God of[01]the Sea's wishes..."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][02][02]"Isso deve ser um[01]presagio...[02]Um sinal da vontade do[01]Deus do Mar..."

lines.text_source: [14][02][02]"All right then, who[01]am I to argue with[01]the God of the Sea?[02]You can come with us[01]on our ship if you[01]want!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][02][02]"Tudo bem, quem sou eu[01]pra discutir com o[01]Deus do Mar?[02]Podem vir com a gente[01]no navio se[01]quiserem!"

lines.text_source: [14][02][02]"Whoa![0B] Wait just a[01]minute there...[02]Don't tell me these[01]ladies here are[01]coming too?"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][02][02]"Espera![0B] Um momento[01]ai...[02]Nao me diga que essas[01]mocas aqui vao[01]vir tambem?"

lines.text_source: [0C][06][14][83]D"Why wouldn't they?[01]You got a problem[01]with that?"
lines.speaker: Ryu
lines.base_translation: [0C][06][14][83]D"Por que nao? Tem algum[01]problema[01]com isso?"

lines.text_source: [14][02][02]"Yeah...I do.[02]We can't let women[01]on board our ship!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][02][02]"E...tenho sim.[02]Mulher nao pode[01]entrar no nosso navio!"

lines.text_source: [14][02][02]"It's an old sailor's[01]rule--no women! It's[01]bad luck!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][02][02]"E uma regra antiga[01]de marinheiro -- mulher[01]da azar!"

lines.text_source: [14][02][02]"So, I'm sorry, but[01]you'll just have to[01]wait here!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][02][02]"Entao, desculpem, mas[01]vao ter que esperar[01]aqui!"

lines.text_source: [14][C1]@"Um...But...Isn't[01]there anything we[01]can do?[02][14][84]EI mean, we've been[01]though a lot just to[01]get here.[02]No matter how bad it[01]might be, I'm sure we[01]can handle it!"
lines.speaker: Nina
lines.base_translation: [14][C1]@"Mas...[01]nao tem nada que a[01]gente possa fazer?[02][14][84]EQuero dizer, passamos[01]por muita coisa pra[01]chegar ate aqui.[02]Por pior que seja, tenho[01]certeza que a gente[01]consegue!"

lines.text_source: [14][02][02]"Nope! Not a chance![02]Look, it's nothing[01]personal, but sailing[01]is a man's job![02]A sailor needs to be[01]brave, determined,[01]and strong..."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][02][02]"Nem pensar![02]Olha, nao e nada pessoal,[01]mas navegar e coisa[01]de homem![02]Marinheiro precisa ser[01]corajoso, determinado[01]e forte..."

lines.text_source: [0C][05][14][05][06]"Whew! Haaaaa![01]We meet again, eh?[02]After you defeated[01]me the second time,[02]I wandered the world[01]until I came here,[02]where I became a[01]sailor!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [0C][05][14][05][06]"Uhuuu! Haaaaa![01]A gente se encontra de novo![02]Depois que voce me derrotou[01]pela segunda vez,[02]errei o mundo ate[01]chegar aqui,[02]onde me tornei[01]marinheiro!"

lines.text_source: [0C][05][14][05][06]"A sailor is a man's[01]man! It's not a job[01]for the weak![02]Only a [05][02]real man[06][01]can become a sailor![02]And now I'm gonna[01]show you exactly[02]what a real man can[01]do!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [0C][05][14][05][06]"Marinheiro e homem de[01]verdade! Nao e pra[01]fraco![02]So um [05][02]homem de verdade[06][01]pode ser marinheiro![02]E agora vou mostrar[01]pra voces[02]o que um homem de[01]verdade faz!"

lines.text_source: [14][02][02]"You friends of his[01]or something?[02]He came here a little[01]while ago...[02]We gave him a job[01]cleaning the ship."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][02][02]"Voces sao amigos[01]dele ou algo assim?[02]Ele apareceu aqui[01]faz pouco...[02]A gente deu a ele o[01]servico de limpar o navio."

lines.text_source: [0C][06][14][C4]@"Hey. You there."
lines.speaker: Ryu

lines.text_source: [0C][06][14][C4]@"You were just[01]talking about how a[02]sailor has to be[01]strong.[02]If we take him out,[01]will that be proof[02]enough that we're[01]strong?"
lines.speaker: Ryu
lines.base_translation: [0C][06][14][C4]@"Voce estava falando[01]que marinheiro precisa[02]ser forte.[02]Se a gente derrotar ele,[01]isso nao prova[02]que somos fortes[01]o suficiente?"

lines.text_source: [14][02][02]"Well...[0B]That's not[01]exactly what I had[01]in mind...[02]See, I'm talking[01]about more like[01]physical strength...[02]Like what if we run[01]into pirates, and[02]you have to fight[01]while on the masts[01]or something?[02]Think you can do[01]that?"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][02][02]"Bom...[0B]Nao era bem[01]isso que eu tinha[01]em mente...[02]Estou falando de[01]forca fisica mesmo...[02]Tipo, e se a gente[01]topar com piratas, e[02]voce tiver que lutar[01]no alto dos mastros[01]ou algo assim?[02]Acha que consegue[01]fazer isso?"

lines.text_source: [14][C1]@"Um, all right. I'll[01]do it."
lines.speaker: Nina
lines.base_translation: [14][C1]@"Tudo bem. Pode deixar."

lines.text_source: [14][02][02]"Um...[0B]...[02]OK, OK, you've made[01]your point. I can see[01]how strong you are."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][02][02]"Bom...[0B]...[02]OK, OK, ponto pra voces.[01]Da pra ver que sao[01]fortes sim."

lines.text_source: [14][02][02]"But I still don't[01]think you can handle[01]the open sea.[02]I mean, you don't[01]know what it's[01]like..."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][02][02]"Mas ainda acho que[01]voces nao aguentam[01]o mar aberto.[02]Quero dizer, voces nao[01]sabem como[01]e..."

lines.text_source: [14][87]E"Then show us! We'll[01]do anything![02]Don't worry--whatever[01]it is, we can handle[01]it!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][87]E"Entao mostra! A gente[01]faz qualquer coisa![02]Pode falar -- o que for,[01]a gente da conta!"

lines.text_source: [14][02][02]"Well...If you say[01]so...[02]I know a way I can[01]show you what it's[01]like on a ship..."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][02][02]"Bom...Se voces insistem...[02]Tenho um jeito de mostrar[01]como e a vida[01]num navio..."

lines.text_source: [14][02][02]"But I'm warning you,[01]it ain't pretty![02]Don't say I didn't[01]warn you!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][02][02]"Mas fica o aviso:[01]nao e nada bonito![02]Nao digam que eu[01]nao avisei!"

lines.text_source: [14][02][02]"All right then, come[01]talk to me when you[01]think you're ready.[02]I'd quit now if I[01]was you, though..."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][02][02]"Quando acharem que[01]estao prontas, voltem[01]falar comigo.[02]Se fosse eu, desistiria[01]agora mesmo..."

lines.text_source: [14][02][02]"What? You still want[01]to go through with[01]it?"[12]
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][02][02]"O que? Ainda querem[01]passar por isso?"[12]

lines.text_source: [14][02][02]"Like I said, I'd[01]quit now if I was[01]you..."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][02][02]"Como disse, eu desistiria[01]agora se fosse[01]voces..."

lines.text_source: "You certainly won't see me[01]trying to get onto a ship[01]like that!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: "Com certeza nao vou ficar[01]tentando entrar num[01]navio desses!"

lines.text_source: "When I grow up, I wanna be[01]a sailor!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: "Quando eu crescer, quero[01]ser marinheiro!"

lines.text_source: "Why can't women sail on[01]ships?[02]Hmmm...Good question. I[01]guess it's just an old[01]tradition."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: "Por que mulher nao pode[01]navegar?[02]Hmm...Boa pergunta. Acho[01]que e so uma tradicao[01]antiga mesmo."

lines.text_source: "A test to let you on board[01]the ship?[02]Yes, they do that for[01]everyone who wants to[01]sail with them."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: "Um teste pra embarcar[01]no navio?[02]E sim, eles fazem isso[01]com todo mundo que quer[01]navegar com eles."

lines.text_source: "Well, have you convinced[01]them to let you on board[01]their ship?"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: "Entao, conseguiram[01]convencer a deixar[01]vocês embarcarem?"

lines.text_source: [14][02][02]"So you still want[01]to go through with[01]this, eh?[02]I figured you would."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][02][02]"Entao ainda querem[01]passar por isso,[01]e?[02]Achei que seria assim."

lines.text_source: [14][02][02]"All right then...[02]Come with me."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][02][02]"Muito bem...[02]Venham comigo."

lines.text_source: [14][C2]@"Maybe we should go[01]check on them..."
lines.speaker: Ryu
lines.base_translation: [14][C2]@"A gente devia ir[01]ver como eles estao..."

lines.text_source: "I heard a lot of strange[01]noises coming from that[02]ship there during the[01]night...[02]What could they have been[01]doing there?"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: "Ouvi uns barulhos estranhos[01]vindo daquele[02]navio la de noite...[02]O que sera que eles[01]estavam fazendo la?"

lines.text_source: "This sea stretches out in[01]all directions.[02]Then, at the edges, it[01]turns into the Sea of Mud."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: "Esse mar se estende[01]em todas as direcoes.[02]La nas bordas, ele[01]vira o Mar de Lama."

lines.text_source: "You know those three[01]fellows who were drinking[01]here the other day?[02]Their names are Zig, Kryrik,[01]and Iggy. They're brothers,[01]and they're all sailors."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: "Conhece aqueles tres caras[01]que estavam bebendo aqui[01]outro dia?[02]Os nomes sao Zig, Kryrik[01]e Iggy. Sao irmaos[01]e todos marinheiros."

lines.text_source: [14][02][02]"Those girls are[01]tougher than I[01]thought![02]They made it through[01]the whole night."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][02][02]"Essas mocas sao mais[01]duras do que eu[01]pensava![02]Aguentaram a noite[01]toda."

lines.text_source: [0C][06][14][C2]@"You're looking a[01]little pale there,[01]Captain.[02]You all right?"
lines.speaker: Ryu
lines.base_translation: [0C][06][14][C2]@"Voce ta um pouco[01]palido, Capitao.[02]Esta bem?"

lines.text_source: [0C][06][14][82]B"Well, I must say[01]I'm impressed.[02]You're strong...[01]You're brave...[02]You girls are really[01]something!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [0C][06][14][82]B"Bom, tenho que admitir[01]que fiquei impressionado.[02]Sao fortes...[01]Sao corajosas...[02]Voces sao demais, meninas!"

lines.text_source: [14][02][02]"All right, all[01]right--you win.[02]I thought you'd give[01]up if you had to[02]spend the night in[01]the hold, but..."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][02][02]"Ta bom, ta bom --[01]voces ganharam.[02]Achei que iam desistir[01]se passassem a[02]noite no porao, mas..."

lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][02][02]"Ta bom, ta bom --[01]voces ganharam.[02]Achei que iam desistir[01]se passassem a[02]noite no porao, mas..."

lines.text_source: [14][02][02]"Yeah...If you're[01]that determined,[02]there's no way I can[01]say no--tradition or[01]no tradition!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][02][02]"E...Se voces sao[01]assim tao decididas,[02]nao tem como dizer nao --[01]tradicao ou[01]nao tradicao!"

lines.text_source: [14][02][02]"Let me know when[01]you're ready to go,[01]and we'll set sail."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][02][02]"Me avisem quando[01]estiverem prontos[01]pra partir."

lines.text_source: [14][02][02]"Well, come back when[01]you're ready, then."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][02][02]"Tudo bem, voltem[01]quando estiverem prontos."

lines.text_source: [14][02][02]"All right then,[01]let's get going!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][02][02]"Muito bem,[01]vamos la!"

lines.text_source: [14][02][02]"Iggy! Kryrik![01]Hoist sail!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][02][02]"Iggy! Kryrik![01]Içam as velas!"

lines.text_source: [14][02][02]"There, you see?[02]Give it up, girl![01]You're just wasting[01]your time!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][02][02]"Ta vendo?[02]Desiste, menina![01]Voce so ta[01]perdendo tempo!"

lines.text_source: [14][02][02]"There! That should[01]teach her a lesson."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][02][02]"Pronto! Isso vai[01]ensinar uma licao a ela."

lines.text_source: [14][02][02]"What? You want to[01]try again?"[12][02][0C][82]Yes[01]No
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][02][02]"O que? Quer[01]tentar de novo?"[12][02][0C][82]Sim[01]Nao

lines.text_source: [14][02][02]"That's what I[01]thought...I'd quit[01]if I was you, girl!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][02][02]"Era o que eu[01]pensava...Desiste,[01]menina!"

lines.text_source: [14][02][02]"All right, if you[01]insist...Iggy, get[01]ready!"
